Designed for critical infrastructure, perimeter protection, coastal monitoring, and border security, the series combines exceptional thermal sensitivity, intelligent analytics, robust cybersecurity, and rugged durability. Featuring industry-leading thermal sensitivity with NETD below 16mK , the cameras capture highly detailed thermal images even in challenging visibility conditions. Advanced AI analytics accurately detect and classify people and vehicles, including those crouching, lying prone, or partially obscured, helping reduce false alarms and improve situational awareness. The series also introduces AI-powered Vessel Detection , extending intelligent surveillance to maritime applications. Operators can accurately identify vessels across coastlines, ports, and waterways, maintaining reliable detection in fog, rain, snow, and complete darkness. Our Story From one office in Johor to a nationwide network AAC Distribution Sdn. Bhd. (200401003622) (formerly known as Alfa Advanced Computer) was established in 1997 in Skudai, Johor Bahru, starting as a computer and hardware supplier with a simple belief: customers deserve a reliable partner who understands their needs and the products they supply. As our business grew, we expanded into CCTV and security solutions, opening our Puchong office in 2004 to better serve customers across the Klang Valley. Nearly three decades later, technology has evolved beyond recognition. From computer hardware and analog CCTV to IP video, AI analytics and cloud-managed networks, we have continued to grow alongside the industry. Yet our commitment remains unchanged. Today, with four offices across Johor and the Klang Valley, we proudly serve dealers, system integrators and installers throughout Malaysia. We don't just supply products. We help our partners build secure, connected and future-ready infrastructure. 29+ Years in the industry 1,500+ Dealer & installer partners 2,000+ Products in our range 4 Offices across Malaysia Our Journey Growing with the technology Each shift in the security industry has moved us forward. subpages.text: Store Solutions & Tech Support About Us Contact Us Sign In Search Products Popular searches ColorVu AcuSense NVR PoE Switch Access Point Face Recognition Cat6 Wi-Fi Camera Store Solutions & Tech All Solutions & Tech Guanlan Large-scale AI Models People Counting Pro Series with ColorVu 3.0 TalkVu IP Video Intercom Hanwha Vision VGA AI Thermal Camera Series Support About Us Contact Us My Account Sign In AI-Powered Security & Networking Intelligence Built Into Every Layer AI is no longer a premium add-on. Across the CCTV, access-control and networking brands we distribute — Hikvision, Hanwha Vision, Ruijie / Reyee and EZVIZ — deep-learning now runs right on the edge: filtering false alarms, reading number plates, recognising faces, counting people and organising your Wi-Fi automatically. Here are the AI capabilities AAC can help you specify and deploy. Hikvision AcuSense Smart Detection & False-Alarm Reduction AcuSense embeds deep-learning algorithms directly into the camera and recorder, detecting and classifying humans and vehicles in real time and pushing instant notifications to your phone — while ignoring the things that don't matter. Filters out animals, falling leaves, heavy rain and light changes, reducing false alarms by up to 90%. Quick Target Search jumps straight to human or vehicle clips instead of scrubbing hours of footage. Perimeter protection with AI-verified line-crossing and intrusion detection along fences and boundaries. Select models add a built-in strobe light and audio warning, triggered only on a confirmed intruder. Hikvision DeepinView ANPR / Licence Plate Recognition DeepinView ANPR cameras automatically read vehicle plate characters at entrances and exits, with high recognition accuracy maintained across different angles and lighting conditions.
